research_result.description: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform offering REST APIs, Web Unblocker, Google SERP scraping, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for seamless AI-agent integration.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free account with no credit card required and generate API keys/tokens directly from the dashboard under API Tokens.

evidence.claim: MrScraper provides an official MCP server with seven tools for web fetching, extraction, SERP, and result retrieval.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: MrScraper MCP connects Model Context Protocol clients to the MrScraper web-data service. It exposes seven tools

evidence.claim: MrScraper API is built on REST principles and uses JSON for requests and responses.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes.

evidence.claim: MrScraper supports API key generation and authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Open MrScraper API Tokens, create a key, and place it in the secret-storage or environment-variable mechanism provided by your MCP client.

evidence.claim: MrScraper supports Bearer token authentication for HTTP endpoints.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: HTTP bearer tokens are validated against the MrScraper account endpoint before tool execution.

evidence.claim: MrScraper offers a free tier requiring no credit card to obtain tokens and access features.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Free plan includes 100 tokens per month with no credit card required.
